title: Explorer: Scaling Exploration-driven Web Trajectory Synthesis for Multimodal Web Agents
authors_zh: Vardaan Pahuja、Yadong Lu、Corby Rosset、Boyu Gou、Arindam Mitra、Spencer Whitehead、Yu Su、Ahmed Hassan Awadallah
paper_type_zh: 多模态网页轨迹合成与筛选配方
best_for_zh: 研究网页智能体训练、实时环境轨迹构造、学习型 verifier 与数据发布审计的读者
one_line: Synthesizes 175K GPT-4o-driven live-web episodes and retains 94K verifier-approved multimodal trajectories for web-agent training.
Explorer 从 175K 次实时网页尝试中保留 94K 条 GPT-4o verifier 接受的多模态轨迹，用于网页智能体 SFT；但官方未提供该语料的不可变快照、清单或专属许可。
why: Shows how exploration, environmental execution, multimodal state capture, and outcome filtering can scale agent data, while exposing why immutable snapshots and content rights are essential release metadata.
inclusion_reason: A concrete large-scale recipe for converting live web exploration into filtered multimodal agent episodes, with useful volume, cost, and execution statistics, but a material gap between the described corpus and released artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative paper is the 24-page Findings of ACL 2025 version in ACL Anthology (pp. 6300–6323, July 2025), including Appendices A–F. The official project page and OSU-NLP-Group/Explorer repository identify the same work and affiliations. The repository exposes generation, training, and evaluation code; it does not link an immutable download of the trajectory corpus.

Explorer addresses a specific construction problem: human-written web demonstrations are expensive, while tasks proposed only from a homepage or from model memory may miss actions and constraints that appear deeper in a site. The proposed alternative lets an agent explore a live page while progressively defining the task it is carrying out, so task intent and executed behavior are created together rather than paired after the fact.

The relevant data object is a multimodal live-web episode: seed URL, evolving task descriptions, grounded and natural-language actions, screenshots and set-of-mark views, HTML/accessibility-tree state, a final high-level task description, and an episode-level verifier decision. The paper reports 175K raw attempts and 94K verifier-approved episodes; a separate 40K sample is scroll-filtered to approximately 30K records for the reported SFT experiments. These populations must not be conflated.

This belongs to data_construction_open_release_recipes because the main reusable contribution is the seed-to-trajectory-to-filter pipeline, including cost, scale, and selection evidence. It is not a resettable web environment, a programmatically verified dataset, or a fully released open corpus. The bilingual Card is L4_chinese_review_ready, while the release remains partial: official sources and code are verified, but the described training records, split manifests, rights, and replay substrate remain unavailable. (Paper §§1–4, Table 3, Appendix A; official repository README.)

权威论文来源是 ACL Anthology 收录的 Findings of ACL 2025 正式版本，共 24 页（第 6300–6323 页，2025 年 7 月），包含附录 A–F。官方项目页和 OSU-NLP-Group/Explorer 仓库指向同一工作与相同机构。仓库公开了生成、训练和评测代码，但没有给出轨迹语料的不可变下载入口。

Explorer 处理一个具体的数据构造问题：人工编写网页 demonstration 成本高；若任务只依据首页或模型记忆提出，又可能漏掉网站深层页面才出现的动作与约束。论文让 agent 在实时页面探索时逐步定义正在执行的任务，使任务意图与实际行为共同产生，而不是事后配对。

这里的数据对象是多模态实时网页 episode：种子 URL、持续变化的任务描述、grounded 与自然语言动作、截图与 set-of-mark 视图、HTML/无障碍树状态、最终高层任务描述，以及 episode 级 verifier 决定。论文报告 175K 次原始尝试与 94K 条 verifier 接受 episode；另从中抽取 40K 条，再经滚动次数过滤得到约 30K 条用于报告的 SFT 实验。这几组数据不能混为一谈。

该工作属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为主要可复用贡献是从种子、轨迹到筛选的流水线，以及成本、规模和选择证据。它不是可重置网页环境、程序化验证数据集或完整开放语料。双语 Card 已达到 L4_chinese_review_ready，但发布状态仍为 partial：官方来源和代码已核验，论文描述的训练记录、split 清单、内容权利和 replay 基底仍不可得。（论文 §§1–4、Table 3、Appendix A；官方仓库 README。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Explorer's contribution is a bottom-up four-role synthesis loop that turns live interaction into both a grounded task and a successful demonstration. A proposer reads the homepage screenshot and accessibility tree, creates an abstract task, and executes the first action. A refiner alternates between choosing the next action and updating the task so it remains consistent with the accumulated history. A summarizer converts the complete action/screenshot history into a high-level intent that omits procedural detail. A verifier then accepts or rejects the episode.

The effective training object is not just the final task–action pair. It is an ordered state-action episode with page observations, two action representations, evolving intent, final summary, and retention status. The action vocabulary in Appendix D comprises click, type, select, scroll up/down, and stop. The paper reports 53K unique initial proposals expanding to 94K final task descriptions, 81K of which are unique; those are description-level counts, not independent correctness guarantees. (Paper Table 9 and Appendix D.)

The feedback contract is learned judgment over environmental evidence. The GPT-4o task verifier receives the final task description, action history, all screenshots, and Markdown for the last page, and predicts success or failure. It can inspect visible trajectory evidence but cannot directly observe hidden server state, independently prove that a transaction or content change occurred, or locate the first erroneous step. Its output filters full episodes; it is not a scalar reward or step label.

Relative to static self-instruct task proposal, Synatra's indirect-knowledge demonstrations, AgentTrek's tutorial-guided replay, and concurrent exploration in a WebArena sandbox, the distinguishing change is to revise the task while executing against many live sites and then summarize what was actually done. Playwright, set-of-mark inputs, GPT-4o roles, SFT, and LLM-as-a-judge are inherited components. The same-model generation-and-verification loop is therefore both the mechanism and a correlated-error risk. (Paper §§2–3 and Appendix F.)

Explorer 的贡献是一条自底向上的四角色合成循环，它把实时交互同时转化为有环境依据的任务和成功 demonstration。proposer 读取首页截图与无障碍树，生成抽象任务并执行第一步；refiner 在选择下一步动作的同时更新任务，使其与累计历史保持一致；summarizer 把完整动作/截图历史转换成不复述操作过程的高层意图；verifier 最后接受或拒绝该 episode。

有效训练对象不只是最终任务—动作对，而是含页面 observation、两种动作表示、变化中的意图、最终摘要和保留状态的有序状态—动作 episode。Appendix D 的动作词表包括 click、type、select、向上/向下 scroll 与 stop。论文报告 53K 个唯一初始 proposal，经探索形成 94K 条最终任务描述，其中 81K 条唯一；这些是描述级计数，并非独立正确性保证。（论文 Table 9 与 Appendix D。）

反馈契约是基于环境证据的学习型判断。GPT-4o task verifier 接收最终任务描述、动作历史、全轨迹截图与最终页面 Markdown，并预测成功或失败。它能查看可见轨迹证据，但不能直接观察隐藏服务端状态、独立证明交易或内容修改确已发生，也不能定位第一处错误步骤。其输出用于筛选完整 episode，不是标量 reward 或步骤标签。

相较于静态 self-instruct 任务生成、Synatra 的间接知识 demonstration、AgentTrek 的教程引导 replay，以及同期在 WebArena sandbox 中的探索方法，Explorer 的关键变化是在大量实时网站上执行时改写任务，再总结 agent 实际完成了什么。Playwright、set-of-mark 输入、GPT-4o 角色、SFT 和 LLM-as-a-judge 都是已有组件。因此，同一模型同时参与生成与验证，既是机制，也带来相关误差风险。（论文 §§2–3 与 Appendix F。）

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are seed sites from the Similarweb top 100 and approximately 49K Tranco URLs; a 4K subset begins with a GPT-4o-generated Google query. Sites containing violent or explicit content are filtered. Playwright opens each live site at up to 1980 × 1080 and records screenshots, raw and set-of-mark views, HTML/accessibility-tree elements, and grounded plus natural-language actions. The paper calls the four role backbones GPT-4o; Appendix B calls the billed synthesis model GPT-4o-turbo, so the exact dated service snapshot is unknown.

The reconstruction pipeline is: seed URL → proposer emits an abstract task and first atomic action → Playwright executes it → refiner conditions on the current page and complete action history, updates the task, and emits the next action → repeat until stop, a step boundary, or a safety/feasibility boundary → summarizer derives a high-level final task description from the full action and screenshot history → task verifier judges the task, actions, screenshots, and last-page Markdown → discard incoherent, misaligned, or unsuccessful episodes. CAPTCHA, login, and payment prompts cause termination; a separate prompt detects CAPTCHA. (Paper §3.2; Appendix D, Tables D.7–D.12.)

The reported collection used 60 parallel processes for 50 hours. Table 3 records 175K raw attempts, 94K accepted trajectories, a 7.7-step accepted-set average, 720K images, 830M tokens, and 33.3M web elements. Appendix B estimates $0.15 per raw attempt and $0.28 per accepted trajectory from a 53.1% success rate. Temperature, seeds, maximum horizon, timestamps, site-level traffic, retries, and an end-to-end run manifest are unknown.

Training adds another selection layer: sample 40K records from the accepted pool, remove episodes with more than two scroll actions, and retain approximately 30K. These state-action records provide SFT targets for Phi-3.5-Vision and Qwen2-VL-7B variants; no RL objective is reported. Appendix A reports batch size 64 and two epochs for Mind2Web-Live synthetic-data runs, with learning rates 4e-5 and 1e-5 respectively. The official repository supplies trajectory-generation, training, and evaluation code, but it expects local raw trajectories and does not provide the original dataset, membership manifests, page snapshots, or fixed environment. Exact reconstruction therefore requires those missing records plus browser, dependency, model-service, locale/session, and website versions.

输入是 Similarweb top 100 与约 49K 个 Tranco URL；其中 4K 条记录先由 GPT-4o 生成 Google 查询以到达目标网站。包含暴力或露骨内容的网站会被过滤。Playwright 以最高 1980 × 1080 的 viewport 打开实时网站，并记录截图、原始与 set-of-mark 视图、HTML/无障碍树元素，以及 grounded 和自然语言动作。正文把四个角色的 backbone 称为 GPT-4o；Appendix B 在费用计算中称其为 GPT-4o-turbo，因此准确的带日期服务 snapshot 为 unknown。

可重建流程为：种子 URL → proposer 生成抽象任务与首个原子动作 → Playwright 执行动作 → refiner 根据当前页面和完整动作历史更新任务并给出下一动作 → 重复，直到 stop、步数边界或安全/可行性边界 → summarizer 从完整动作和截图历史生成高层最终任务 → task verifier 判断任务、动作、截图和最终页 Markdown → 丢弃不连贯、偏离意图或失败的 episode。遇到 CAPTCHA、登录或支付请求会终止；另有独立 prompt 检测 CAPTCHA。（论文 §3.2；Appendix D，Tables D.7–D.12。）

论文报告的采集运行使用 60 个并行进程，耗时 50 小时。Table 3 记录 175K 次原始尝试、94K 条接受轨迹、接受集平均 7.7 步、720K 张图像、830M tokens 与 33.3M 个网页元素。Appendix B 按 53.1% 成功率估算每次原始尝试 0.15 美元、每条接受轨迹 0.28 美元。temperature、seed、最大 horizon、采集时间戳、站点级流量、retry 和端到端运行清单均为 unknown。

训练还增加一层选择：从接受池抽取 40K 条，删除滚动动作超过两次的 episode，最终保留约 30K 条。这些状态—动作记录为 Phi-3.5-Vision 与 Qwen2-VL-7B 变体提供 SFT target；论文未报告 RL 目标。Appendix A 对 Mind2Web-Live 合成数据实验给出 batch size 64、2 个 epoch，Phi-3.5V 与 Qwen2-VL-7B 的 learning rate 分别为 4e-5 与 1e-5。官方仓库提供轨迹生成、训练和评测代码，但要求本地传入原始轨迹，并未提供原始语料、成员清单、页面快照或固定环境。精确重建还需补齐这些记录，以及浏览器、依赖、模型服务、locale/session 和网站版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence about the data itself is the documented construction funnel and the verifier audit. Table 3 distinguishes 175K raw attempts from 94K accepted episodes and explicitly assigns the 49K unique URLs, 7.7 average steps, 720K images, 830M tokens, and 33.3M elements to the accepted set. Table 9 further reports 53K unique proposals, 94K final task descriptions, and 81K unique final descriptions. These counts establish scale and observed description diversity under the authors' procedure; they do not establish legality, decontamination, replayability, or item-level success.

On a random human-reviewed sample of 100 generated trajectories, Table 10 reports 81% agreement with the task verifier. Its normalized confusion matrix contains 0.14 human-labeled failures predicted successful and 0.05 human-labeled successes predicted failed. This directly demonstrates both false acceptance and false rejection. It is a calibration sample for the filter, not proof that all 94K accepted records are correct.

Under the authors' 83-task accessible subset of Mind2Web-Live, Table 5 reports full-task success of 18.1% for Explorer-4B versus 2.4% for Phi-3.5V, and 19.3% for Explorer-7B versus 14.5% for Qwen2-VL-7B. Appendix A states that these values are the maximum over three runs; on all 104 tasks, Appendix Table A.1 reports both Explorer models at 16.4%. On Multimodal-Mind2Web, synthetic-only Explorer-4B and Explorer-7B reach average step success of 37.4 and 43.0; Table 6 also shows that adding Mind2Web training changes the comparison. On MiniWob++ zero-shot, Table 8 reports 46.74 and 53.26 accuracy versus 45.28 for AgentTrek-7B and 36.96 for the Qwen2-VL-7B baseline.

Figure 3 reports monotonic improvement for 25%, 50%, and 100% data subsets averaged over three runs, but the ablation changes data amount within the selected training recipe rather than independently validating trajectory quality. Table A.3 also shows model-backbone sensitivity: full-task success is 4.8 for LLaVA-Mistral-7B, 13.3 for text-only Phi-3-mini, 18.1 for Phi-3.5V, and 19.3 for Qwen2-VL-7B. All benchmark results are author-reported; live-site selection, learned judging, backbone, and training setup constrain attribution.

The official repository contains synthesis, SFT, and evaluation code under MIT terms and showed no tagged release when checked. It provides command placeholders for local trajectory paths rather than an official corpus download. Code availability therefore supports recipe inspection, not a claim that the 94K episodes, rejected attempts, checksums, data card, or dataset license are public.

与数据本身最直接相关的证据是构建漏斗和 verifier 审计。Table 3 区分 175K 次原始尝试与 94K 条接受 episode，并明确说明 49K 个唯一 URL、平均 7.7 步、720K 张图像、830M tokens 和 33.3M 个元素属于接受集。Table 9 又报告 53K 个唯一 proposal、94K 条最终任务描述和 81K 条唯一最终描述。这些计数支持作者流程下的规模与可观察描述多样性，但不能证明合法性、无污染、可重放性或逐条成功。

在随机抽取并由人工复核的 100 条生成轨迹上，Table 10 报告 task verifier 与人工判断一致率为 81%。归一化混淆矩阵包含 0.14 的“人工标为失败、verifier 判为成功”和 0.05 的“人工标为成功、verifier 判为失败”。这直接显示误接受与误拒绝。它是对筛选器的小样本校准，不是全部 94K 条接受记录均正确的证明。

在作者选择的 83 条可访问 Mind2Web-Live 任务上，Table 5 报告 Explorer-4B 的 full-task success 为 18.1%，Phi-3.5V 为 2.4%；Explorer-7B 为 19.3%，Qwen2-VL-7B 为 14.5%。Appendix A 说明这些值取三次运行的最大值；在全部 104 条任务上，Appendix Table A.1 报告两个 Explorer 模型均为 16.4%。在 Multimodal-Mind2Web 上，仅使用合成轨迹的 Explorer-4B 与 Explorer-7B 的平均 step success 分别为 37.4 和 43.0；Table 6 也表明加入 Mind2Web 训练会改变比较。在 MiniWob++ zero-shot 评测中，Table 8 报告 46.74 与 53.26 accuracy，对照 AgentTrek-7B 为 45.28，Qwen2-VL-7B 基线为 36.96。

Figure 3 报告 25%、50% 与 100% 数据子集在三次运行平均后单调改善，但该消融改变的是既定训练配方内的数据量，不能独立验证轨迹质量。Table A.3 还显示 backbone 敏感性：LLaVA-Mistral-7B、纯文本 Phi-3-mini、Phi-3.5V 与 Qwen2-VL-7B 的 full-task success 分别为 4.8、13.3、18.1 与 19.3。所有 benchmark 结果均由作者报告；实时站点选择、学习型裁判、backbone 与训练设置都会限制归因。

官方仓库以 MIT 条款公开合成、SFT 与评测代码，核查时没有 tagged release。命令需要传入本地轨迹路径，而不是提供官方语料下载。因此，代码可得支持的是配方检查，不能据此宣称 94K episode、拒绝尝试、checksum、data card 或数据集许可已经公开。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior web-agent data work commonly begins with fixed human tasks, homepage-only/self-instruct proposals, synthetic grounding examples, or tutorial-guided replay. Explorer changes the construction order: low-level actions reveal real page affordances, the task is revised to remain consistent with those actions, and only after execution does a summarizer recover the final high-level intent. This makes task creation, behavior generation, and environmental grounding one coupled process.

The new data operation is the evolving task state. One accepted record preserves a path from abstract proposal through action-conditioned refinements to a final description, paired with multimodal page state and a learned success decision. The raw-to-accepted funnel, 60-process/50-hour collection run, cost model, and separate scroll-filtered SFT subset make the recipe more operational than a paper that reports only a final trajectory count.

The paper does not invent Playwright, ReAct-style interaction, set-of-mark screenshots, GPT-4o generation, LLM-as-a-judge filtering, Phi-3.5-Vision/Qwen2-VL backbones, or SFT. Its scale and integration should not be described as a new deterministic verifier or a complete open-data release. The learned verifier sees visible evidence rather than ground-truth server state, and the original live pages are not frozen.

For the atlas, the direction signal is exploration-driven task synthesis: allow the environment to shape the instruction instead of requiring a complete task before any action. Before reusing this pattern, inspect whether task revision creates hindsight labels, whether generator and verifier errors are correlated, whether failed paths are retained, whether page content can be redistributed, and whether per-record timestamps and snapshots make the lineage auditable. The 81% human-verifier agreement and missing corpus snapshot are central boundaries, not footnotes.

既有网页智能体数据工作通常从固定人工任务、只看首页的 self-instruct proposal、合成 grounding 样例或教程引导 replay 开始。Explorer 改变了构造顺序：低层动作先暴露真实页面 affordance，任务随之改写以保持与动作一致，执行结束后 summarizer 再恢复最终高层意图。任务创建、行为生成和环境 grounding 因而成为同一耦合过程。

新的数据操作是“持续变化的任务状态”。一条接受记录保留从抽象 proposal、动作条件下的多轮 refinement 到最终描述的路径，同时配有多模态页面状态和学习型成功决定。原始到接受的漏斗、60 进程/50 小时采集运行、成本模型，以及单独进行滚动过滤的 SFT 子集，使该配方比只报告最终轨迹数的工作更具操作性。

论文没有发明 Playwright、ReAct 式交互、set-of-mark 截图、GPT-4o 生成、LLM-as-a-judge 筛选、Phi-3.5-Vision/Qwen2-VL backbone 或 SFT。其规模与工程集成不应被表述为新的确定性 verifier 或完整开放数据发布。学习型 verifier 看到的是可见证据而非真实服务端状态，原始实时页面也没有被冻结。

对 atlas 而言，方向信号是 exploration-driven task synthesis：允许环境塑造 instruction，而不是在动作开始前就要求完整任务。复用该模式前，应检查任务改写是否形成 hindsight label、generator 与 verifier 误差是否相关、失败路径是否保留、页面内容是否有再分发权，以及逐条时间戳和快照能否支持 lineage 审计。81% 的人机一致率和缺失语料快照是核心边界，而不是附带细节。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The acceptance label is noisy and circular. GPT-4o participates in proposing, refining, summarizing, and judging; correlated blind spots can survive every stage. The 100-example audit records both false acceptance (0.14 of the normalized matrix) and false rejection (0.05), while the paper does not release all raw verifier outputs or stratify errors by site, task type, length, or safety boundary. Successful-only retention removes failures and near misses needed to recalibrate the filter, study recovery, or construct preference data.

The authors' qualitative failure analysis identifies grounding errors during refinement, unresponsive websites, summarization hallucination, technical barriers such as login/media/bot detection, and episodes incomplete at the step limit. The verifier can also mistake visible final-page evidence for actual completion because hidden server state and side effects are outside its observation. Curator inference: a model may exploit stylistic regularities shared by the generator and judge without learning robust task completion.

Live pages drift, disappear, personalize results, change layout, and trigger bot defenses. URLs alone cannot replay a record without timestamped page snapshots, browser/dependency versions, viewport, locale, cookies/session state, network logs, and exact prompts/model snapshots. Mind2Web-Live results further exclude 21 inaccessible tasks for the main table and select the maximum of three runs, so accessibility variance and reporting policy affect comparison.

Release coverage is incomplete. No official immutable 94K snapshot, raw 175K pool, 40K sample, approximately 30K final training set, membership mapping, rejected episodes, checksums, or corpus-specific license was identified. Temperature, seeds, maximum collection horizon, per-site counts, decontamination, source duplication, and train/evaluation overlap are unknown. The MIT repository license covers code, and ACL's CC BY 4.0 covers the paper text; neither establishes redistribution rights for captured screenshots, HTML, accessibility trees, task text, or third-party page content.

The paper states that no personal information is used during execution, that agents stop at CAPTCHA/login/payment, and that a subset is monitored for access-policy compliance. It does not publish a corpus-wide privacy/redaction audit, site-level terms/robots ledger, consent record, or request-rate log. These are missing disclosures, not evidence that the authors performed no controls.

接受标签同时存在噪声与循环性。GPT-4o 参与提出任务、改写任务、总结和判断，相关盲点可能穿过全部阶段。100 条样本的审计同时记录误接受（归一化矩阵中的 0.14）与误拒绝（0.05），但论文没有公开全部原始 verifier 输出，也没有按网站、任务类型、长度或安全边界做分层误差分析。只保留成功样本还会删除校准筛选器、研究恢复或构建偏好数据所需的失败与 near miss。

作者的定性失败分析包括 refinement 阶段 grounding error、网站无响应、summarization hallucination、登录/媒体/机器人检测等技术障碍，以及达到步数上限但任务未完成。verifier 还可能把可见最终页证据误当作真实完成，因为隐藏服务端状态与副作用不在其观察内。Curator inference：模型可能利用 generator 与 judge 共享的风格规律，而没有学到稳健任务完成。

实时页面会漂移、消失、个性化、改变布局并触发 bot defense。若缺少带时间戳的页面快照、浏览器/依赖版本、viewport、locale、cookie/session 状态、网络日志与准确 prompt/model snapshot，仅凭 URL 无法重放记录。Mind2Web-Live 主表还排除了 21 条不可访问任务，并对三次运行取最大值，因此可访问性波动与报告政策都会影响比较。

发布范围不完整。没有核实到官方不可变 94K 快照、原始 175K 池、40K sample、最终约 30K 训练集、成员映射、拒绝 episode、checksum 或语料专属 license。temperature、seed、最大采集 horizon、站点级数量、去污染、来源去重和训练/评测重叠均为 unknown。MIT 仓库许可覆盖代码，ACL 的 CC BY 4.0 覆盖论文文本；两者都不能确立截图、HTML、无障碍树、任务文本或第三方页面内容的再分发权。

论文称执行时不使用个人信息，agent 遇到 CAPTCHA/登录/支付会停止，并对部分轨迹监测访问政策合规性。但项目没有公开全语料隐私/脱敏审计、站点级 terms/robots 清单、consent 记录或请求速率日志。这些是缺失披露，不等于作者一定没有执行相关控制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, Explorer is a concrete blueprint for turning mutable environments into post-training episodes. A reimplementation can separate seed selection, action-conditioned task refinement, state capture, trajectory summarization, episode judgment, success filtering, and training-subset filtering, while logging every transition between raw, accepted, sampled, and final SFT populations.

The paper is also useful for verifier design and audit. Its 100-item human comparison shows why an LLM success filter needs a confusion matrix rather than an unqualified “successful” label. A stronger replication should preserve verifier logits or rationales, human disagreements, all rejected and near-miss paths, task/site/length strata, hidden-state checks where possible, and sensitivity to an independent judge family.

For controlled experiments, the reported recipe motivates comparisons between fixed tasks and evolving tasks; raw versus accepted episodes; success-only SFT versus mixtures containing failures; alternative scroll filters; independent versus shared generator/verifier models; and 25/50/100% training subsets under fixed model and compute. The official code is a starting point for these modules, but live-page drift and missing run settings prevent exact reconstruction of the original records.

The justified reuse class is reading/audit and recipe reimplementation reference. Training reuse of the reported corpus is blocked because the corpus, membership manifests, content rights, privacy review, and split/decontamination records were not verified. The 94K figure should be cited as a paper-reported accepted collection, not as a downloadable dataset.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes track，Explorer 是把可变环境转化为 post-training episode 的具体蓝图。重实现时可拆分种子选择、动作条件任务 refinement、状态采集、轨迹总结、episode 判断、成功筛选和训练子集筛选，并记录原始、接受、抽样与最终 SFT 各 population 之间的每次转换。

论文也适合用于 verifier 设计与审计。100 条人工对照说明，LLM 成功筛选器需要混淆矩阵，而不能只给出未经限定的“successful”标签。更强的复现应保留 verifier logit 或 rationale、人工分歧、全部拒绝与 near-miss 路径、按任务/网站/长度分层的结果、可行时的隐藏状态检查，以及对独立 judge family 的敏感性。

在受控实验中，该配方可以支持以下对照：固定任务与变化任务、原始与接受 episode、只用成功样本的 SFT 与含失败样本的 mixture、不同滚动过滤规则、独立与共享 generator/verifier，以及固定模型和 compute 下的 25/50/100% 训练子集。官方代码可作为这些模块的起点，但实时页面漂移与缺失运行设置阻止精确重建原始记录。

证据充分支持的复用等级是阅读/审计与配方重实现参考。所报告语料的训练复用仍被阻塞，因为语料本体、成员清单、内容权利、隐私复核和 split/去污染记录都未核实。94K 应引用为“论文报告的接受集合”，不能写成可下载数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3, Tables 3–4, and Appendix B together: 175K raw attempts become 94K verifier-approved episodes; accepted-set averages are 7.7 steps, 720K images, 830M tokens, and 33.3M elements, at reported costs of $0.15 per attempt and $0.28 per accepted episode.
  • Keep the training subset separate from the accepted pool: 40K accepted records are sampled, episodes with more than two scroll actions are removed, and approximately 30K records train Phi-3.5-Vision and Qwen2-VL-7B variants.
  • Treat Table 10's 81% agreement on 100 human-audited trajectories as evidence of verifier noise; the matrix includes both human failures accepted by the verifier and human successes rejected by it.
  • Read Appendix A before quoting Mind2Web-Live: the main table uses 83 accessible tasks and the maximum of three runs; the all-104-task appendix result is 16.4% full-task success for both Explorer models.
  • Separate recipe release from data release: official MIT code exists, but no immutable 94K corpus, failed pool, checksums, membership/split manifests, dataset license, or historical page-state archive was identified.
  • Pair this Card with static-task, tutorial-guided, and sandboxed web-trajectory work to test whether evolving task descriptions increase useful coverage or introduce hindsight and shared-judge bias.

• 联读 §3、Tables 3–4 与 Appendix B：175K 次原始尝试经筛选成为 94K 条 verifier 接受 episode；接受集平均 7.7 步、含 720K 张图像、830M tokens 与 33.3M 个元素，报告成本为每次尝试 0.15 美元、每条接受 episode 0.28 美元。
  • 将训练子集与接受池分开：作者从接受记录抽取 40K 条，删除滚动动作超过两次的 episode，最终约 30K 条用于训练 Phi-3.5-Vision 与 Qwen2-VL-7B 变体。
  • 把 Table 10 在 100 条人工审计轨迹上的 81% 一致率理解为 verifier 噪声证据；矩阵同时包含被 verifier 接受的人工失败样本和被拒绝的人工成功样本。
  • 引用 Mind2Web-Live 前先读 Appendix A：主表使用 83 条可访问任务，并取三次运行最大值；包含全部 104 条任务的附录结果显示两个 Explorer 模型的 full-task success 都是 16.4%。
  • 区分配方发布与数据发布：官方 MIT 代码存在，但没有核实到不可变 94K 语料、失败池、checksum、成员/split 清单、数据集许可或历史页面状态归档。
  • 将本卡与静态任务、教程引导和 sandbox 网页轨迹工作配合阅读，检验变化中的任务描述究竟增加了有效覆盖，还是引入 hindsight 与共享 judge 偏差。
